methodology_note: candidate English tokens = Latin-script tokens NOT attested as any Sinhala word's romanization in data/raw/swabhasha_words.csv, unioned with the already-verified 123-entry loanword table. SOLD rates are reported both raw and after stripping Twitter-scrape artifacts (quoted-tweet headers, @USER/URL placeholders, hashtags, domains). Every candidate here still requires hand verification before use — see scripts/build_codemix_lexicon.py. eka_construction_vocabulary is a second, stronger channel: English stems observed directly attached to a Sinhala 'එක' case particle in SOLD's own raw text — the exact construction the noiser produces, so it recovers words the Latin-token filter above missed via a coincidental Swa-Bhasha collision.
